methodology: V candidate parser: 12 cases, three fixed and three seeded-shuffled repeats; visible 36: three separate trials. Monotonic process-local wall and process CPU. Scripted point is inert and always unchecked; no model/network/feed call. Synthetic source roles are not authenticated; independent semantic adjudication is absent.

real_model.reason: no separately approved endpoint/model, export scope, credential or billing oracle

limitations: Synthetic fixture roles are not source authentication.
Atomic source records bind bytes and parser decisions; semantic truth requires independent review.
Raw scripted prose is unchecked and never reportable.
Phrase absence is a negative source check; phrase presence would need human entailment review.
No real model, billed tokens, provider cost, or model advantage measured.
Timeout checks cannot preempt arbitrary blocking providers; only the inert local adapter is executed.
Process peak RSS is cumulative for this run, not a per-case measurement.
